state:
Goal `core-request-1-2`: `Core\Request::body`, `Core\Request::bytes` and `Core\Request::bodyStream`
have all their feature proofs, and `bun nv proofs --verify --only` over those three says nothing owed.
A proof program answers a request through the `<name>.nvsr` beside it (`docs/examples/README.md` §
*A request for the program*). `nvs run --request` hands the body over as one piece, so an example
must not print a count of pieces. A body can be streamed once per request, so the `bodyStream` bench
declares `iterations 1`, the way `benches/members/core/IO/stdin.nvs` does. The remaining eight
members of `Core\Request (1/2)` owe their proofs one at a time, in the order the check lists them.
